title: The Last Thorn Again
author: Ansel Eastwick
blurb: Elodie Vasquez, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
